detail.longDescription: Hi ! I'm finishing my MBA and I'm researching where AI actually helps (or doesn't) in outbound B2B prospecting. Given your experience, your answer would mean a lot: 10 min, anonymous → https://ai-sales-b2b-research-denis.vercel.app/ — for every 30 valid responses I will raffle a US$50/€50 Amazon gift card. The results will be public.
